subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my note about driving qualified property leads for {Brand} in the ZIPs you actively monetize. The one point worth repeating: we optimize MAFO to the qualified property lead and read it back through a server-to-server postback carrying listing ID, ZIP, and intent tier before it counts, so an aged, duplicate, or synthetic inquiry never bills. At scale we hold around 4,200 qualified property leads a day on that clean event. If it helps, I can pull the buyer-versus-seller breakdown for your live metros. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate qualified property lead postback proof
illustrative_flags: 4,200 qualified property leads a day (MobUpps-specific daily qualified-lead volume; illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN real_estate_proptech: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (qualified-lead S2S postback with listing ID + ZIP + intent tier, dedupe/validation); one illustrative MobUpps figure (4,200/day); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off, no em-dash, no 'X, not Y' (positive phrasing 'never bills'); native English, Brand named only from candidates.
